source: Real normative kinematics derived from WBDS (Fukuchi, Fukuchi & Duarte 2018), 24 young healthy adults (age 21-37, mean 27.6; 14 M/10 F), overground comfortable speed, right limb, time-normalised to the 101-point gait cycle. Sagittal angles = Z axis (ecosystem convention); frontal/transverse axes resolved by matching published normative shape (Perry & Burnfield 2010; Winter 1991). foot_progression = FootAngleY (transverse).
citation: Fukuchi CA, Fukuchi RK, Duarte M (2018) PeerJ 6:e4640 doi:10.7717/peerj.4640; Schwartz & Rozumalski (2008) Gait Posture 28:351-357.
